findings.title: IOCP/Winsock close failures are not sticky and may later report quiescent/replacement

evidence.detail: CloseHandle and WSACleanup failure propagate with ?; no fault field/store is changed. A later call can retry these releases then set drained=true.
Synchronous finish contains the same release/retry pattern.
When eventually drained=true, Drop releases OWNER_ACTIVE. No OWNER_FAULTED store occurs on these IOCP/Winsock release error paths.

findings.consequence: A checked cleanup failure can be reclassified as successful shutdown on the same owner; new caller generation can then replace it. Retrying a handle release after uncertain failure also conflicts with exact-original reference retention. The issue is inherited cleanup code exposed by configured production startup/stop; review does not claim an observed Windows failure.
findings.minimalFix: Record the first IOCP/Winsock checked-close failure as a sticky per-owner cleanup fault and process admission fault; preserve the original bounded resources, prohibit repeated release of uncertain references, and never return shutdown true or clear admission after that failure. Apply consistently to finish and poll_http_drain; ensure any earlier socket cleanup fault also cannot yield later quiescent true.
findings.notification: Sent concrete line evidence and recommendation to root and production_backend before report.

confirmedStaticProperties.conclusion: OWNER_ACTIVE/OWNER_FAULTED and worker ADMITTED/CLEANUP_FAULTED are process static. An undrained Owner Drop retains ManuallyDrop Resources and permanently faults admission; merely exiting the old HTTP thread cannot reset these gates.

Explicit validated policy precedes listener startup; same owner retains worker during initialization, and failure of finish maps to distinct ConfiguredTlsError::Cleanup rather than successful readiness.

SO_UPDATE_ACCEPT_CONTEXT/getpeername/policy execute while bare socket remains its owner, before business slot assignment/SSPI submission. A source rejection closes exact bare socket before replenishing and increments source_rejections. Capacity rejection is independently negative when no ready slot exists.

Each AcceptEx address region is48 bytes >=28-byte SOCKADDR_IN6+16; total96. Exact IPv6-only bind and checked family/length decoding preserve network-byte ordering; mapped/scoped endpoints are refused. Domain policy is nonempty max16, canonical hostbits with family-specific membership and bounded retained capacity.

confirmedStaticProperties.conclusion: Same selected CurrentUser MY context supplies time/EKU/SAN/private-key checks and AcquireCredentialsHandleW before listener creation. SAN only supports DNS/IP; every other GeneralName is explicitly rejected, even a valid URI or directoryName. This is a capability restriction, not validation of every SAN topology or browser trust.
